title: Tanvi Sharma Wins Maiden BWF World Tour Title, Becomes Youngest Champion
indian_angle: Indian teenager Tanvi Sharma secured her first BWF World Tour title, becoming the youngest player to achieve this historic feat.
summary: The 17-year-old Indian shuttler Tanvi Sharma claimed her maiden BWF World Tour title in Chinese Taipei, winning the final in straight games after having lost three previous finals.

title: BAI Releases Player Eligibility Criteria for World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has released crucial guidelines for Indian players aspiring to be selected for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued a circular detailing the eligibility criteria for Indian players for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament Now World Junior Selection Event
indian_angle: The Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament has been declared the official selection tournament for Indian players for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: Following the postponement of the Haryana U-19 Ranking Tournament, the Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament has been designated as the sole selection event for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change to a 3x15 scoring system will impact all U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a new 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.

title: BAI Issues Advisory Against Unauthorized Badminton Leagues and Tournaments
indian_angle: Indian players and coaches are advised by BAI to avoid participating in unauthorized badminton leagues and tournaments to ensure compliance and safety.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued an advisory cautioning players and coaches against participating in unauthorized badminton leagues, tournaments, and championships, citing specific examples like 'Passion Sphere presents Badminton Premier League – Season 2'.
